title: Recovery Department Schedule: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Repossession Thresholds and Expenses
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — repossession figures by tier.**

| Tier | Minimum days past due before assignment for repossession |
|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 60 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 60 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 75 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 75 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 90 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 90 |

Figures common to every tier:

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Notice of intent to sell mailed within | 3 business days after the repossession date |
| Agency fee, involuntary recovery | 425.00 USD |
| Agency fee, voluntary surrender | 175.00 USD |
| Transport fee (involuntary recovery only) | 150.00 USD |
| Condition report fee (once per repossession) | 75.00 USD |
| Storage per day beyond the free days | 20.00 USD |
| Storage days not charged after repossession | 3 |
| Personal property held before it may be disposed of | 15 calendar days |

## Reading the schedule

- The days-past-due figure is a minimum: a Tier 3 account at 75 days past due has reached it; one at 74 has not.
- Storage is charged only for days beyond the first 3: a vehicle stored for a hypothetical 8 days carries 5 charged days at 20.00 dollars each, 100.00 dollars; one stored for 3 days or fewer carries no storage charge.
- A voluntary surrender carries the 175.00 dollar agency fee and no transport fee; an involuntary recovery carries the 425.00 dollar agency fee and the 150.00 dollar transport fee.
